ValidationRule.description: R-GR3: a line of a deposit is money that came in. Zero is not a line, and money that went back is a refund recorded against the gift it reverses (R-G3), never a negative line in a batch. An empty amount is allowed while the batch is being typed and stops it posting.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter an amount greater than zero. To record money that went back, refund the gift it came from rather than adding a negative line here.
